items.detail: Hours or days week by week, duties included and excluded, and the end date. Germany: a graduated return (Hamburger Modell) runs while the employee is still on sick status.

items.text: Lactation: break schedule, private non-bathroom space and duration
items.detail: California LC 1030-1034; Colorado up to 2 years after birth; Washington paid lactation breaks from 1 Jan 2027; nursing breaks in China, Taiwan, India, Israel and Vietnam.

items.text: Statutory part-time or schedule requests
items.detail: Germany: part-time after Elternzeit (§8 TzBfG, more than 15 employees) or bridge part-time (§9a, more than 45); reply within the statutory deadline or consent may be deemed.

items.text: Review date for each accommodation or phased element

Reinstatement to the same or an equivalent (US) or comparable (Canada) role confirmed: title, level, pay, grade, reporting line, location and shift. Any change is documented with its business reason and reviewed by Legal before the return.
Merit increases, bonus and equity awarded to the team during the leave applied as they would have been, as agreed with Total Rewards.
Darwinbox leave status ended from the return date; accounts, badge, lab and design-environment access restored (with an export re-screen if the project changed).
Payroll restarts salary and deductions, ends top-up or SUB payments and sets any premium-arrears recovery within policy caps.
Mandatory training that lapsed during the leave assigned with a realistic deadline.
Two-week reboarding plan
items.detail: Project and org changes, tool and flow updates, key decisions made during the leave, people to meet and first deliverables.

items.text: Workload plan for the first 30 days
items.detail: Start with scoped deliverables; don't hand over the backlog that built up during the leave.

items.text: Check-in schedule
items.detail: Week 1, day 30 and the end of any phased return; monthly for 3 months after a long medical leave.

items.text: How is the return going? What's working, and what would make the next few weeks easier?
items.detail: Probe: workload, schedule, energy, care or lactation needs, and any restriction that isn't working. Record agreed changes, not medical detail.

items.text: Actions agreed at each check-in (owner and date)
Goals pro-rated for the time worked in the cycle; the rating reflects work performed, not the absence

Leave and reserve duty don't reduce ratings, bonus or promotion eligibility beyond documented pro-ration where lawful (Taiwan protects up to 10 sick days a year; Israel requires reserve neutrality; protected leave in the US and Germany can't be penalized).
Employee included in the current compensation review and promotion calibration, with the leave dates noted for calibrators.
Any PIP, warning or other adverse action within 90 days of the return is reviewed by Employee Relations and Legal before it happens.

Germany: after more than 6 weeks' illness in 12 months (continuous or cumulative), offer BEM in writing with data-protection information and involve the works council and SBV (§167(2) SGB IX). A sickness-based dismissal without a proper BEM offer usually fails.

Canada: the duty to accommodate to the point of undue hardship applies on return, and Ontario employers with 50+ employees must document an individual return-to-work process (AODA). Reinstate after ESA leave to the same or a comparable job with seniority intact.

Israel: a returning mother can't be dismissed or have her role or hours cut for 60 days and gets a daily nursing hour for 4 months; a returning reservist is protected for 30 days (60 with 60+ cumulative reserve days in the year).

Vietnam: a returning mother gets her old job, or another at no lower pay if it no longer exists (LC Art. 140). China: 1 hour a day of nursing time until the child's first birthday, and no extended hours or night work in that period.
Sign-off: employee, manager, case manager and HRBP (dates); leave case closed, with any continuing accommodation left open in LV-02 with its review date

notes: Plan the return before the return date. Coming back to no laptop, no access and no plan reads as a signal about the employee's future.
Ask for fitness-for-duty documentation only where the law and a uniform policy allow it, and share only the restrictions with the manager.
Compare the pre-leave and post-return role, pay and reporting line; any change needs a documented reason and Legal review.
Pro-rate goals and don't penalize the absence; counting protected leave against a rating or bonus is one of the most common retaliation findings.
Watch the 90 days after the return: courts and tribunals in most of our countries view adverse action in that window with suspicion.
Close the leave case, but keep any continuing accommodation open in LV-02 with its own review date.

countryNotes.us: FMLA requires restoration to the same or an equivalent job, and a fitness-for-duty certificate can be required only if announced in the designation notice and limited to the condition. The ADA may require finite extra leave or modified duties, and USERRA applies the escalator principle to returning service members.
countryNotes.us-ca: Reinstate after CFRA or PDL to the same or a comparable position, and handle restrictions through the FEHA interactive process (failing to engage is a separate violation). Provide lactation breaks and a compliant private space (LC 1030-1034).
countryNotes.us-co: FAMLI requires reinstatement to the same or an equivalent position, with benefits restored, for employees with 180+ days' employment, and retaliation for FAMLI or HFWA use is prohibited. Provide lactation accommodation for up to 2 years after birth.
countryNotes.us-nc: No state reinstatement rule beyond National Guard state duty (apply within 24 hours or 14 days; reinstate within 5 days) and federal FMLA and USERRA. Refusing suitable work can suspend workers' comp, but terminating a comp claimant invites REDA retaliation claims.
countryNotes.us-tx: No Texas reinstatement rules beyond jury service and Texas military forces duty; FMLA, ADA and USERRA govern. For work injuries, coordinate the return with the carrier, or under the plan's return-to-work terms for non-subscribers.
countryNotes.us-wa: Restore employees returning from job-protected PFML to the same or an equivalent job (25+ employees in 2026, 180 days' service). WLAD requires reinstatement after pregnancy-disability leave, and lactation breaks are paid from 1 Jan 2027.
countryNotes.ca: Reinstate after ESA leave to the same job, or a comparable one if it no longer exists, with seniority and benefits intact, and accommodate to the point of undue hardship. Ontario employers with 50+ employees need a documented AODA return-to-work process.
countryNotes.de: Offer BEM in writing after more than 6 weeks' sickness in 12 months, and run any graduated return (Hamburger Modell) while the employee is still on sick status. Returners from Elternzeit resume contractual hours, with rights to part-time (§8 TzBfG) or bridge part-time (§9a).
countryNotes.il: A returning mother can't be dismissed or have her role or hours cut for 60 days and gets the daily nursing hour for 4 months. Returning reservists are protected for 30 days (60 with 60+ cumulative reserve days under the 2026 order), and the absence can't count against ratings or bonuses.
countryNotes.in: Provide nursing breaks after maternity leave (verify the current number and duration under the SS Code) and agree work from home where the role allows. Establishments with 50+ employees must provide a creche.
countryNotes.tw: Reinstate employees returning from unpaid parental leave to their role; refusal is allowed only on narrow statutory business grounds (Gender Equality in Employment Act Art. 17, verify). Provide breastfeeding breaks, and don't let protected leave or up to 10 sick days a year affect appraisal, promotion or transfer.
countryNotes.cn: Nursing protections run until the child's first birthday (1 hour a day, no extended hours or night work). When a medical treatment period ends, an Art. 40 termination is possible only if the employee can't do the original or rearranged work, so plan redeployment first.
countryNotes.vn: A returning mother gets her old job, or another at no lower pay if it no longer exists (LC Art. 140), plus a 60-minute daily nursing break until the child is 12 months. She may return early after at least 4 months with a medical certificate and the employer's agreement.
